description: Count unread (unseen) emails per folder, plus a total. Use for "how many unread do I have?" overviews. Defaults to all folders; pass a folders list to limit scope and speed it up.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

folders.description: List of folders to check (default: all)

name: imap_get_unread_count
